title: ruta chalepensis var. latifolia
intro: Ruta chalepensis var. latifolia, commonly known as the Syrian Rue, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in the treatment of conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Syrian Rue include analgesic, antipyretic, and spasmolytic effects, which can help in alleviating pain, reducing fever, and relaxing muscles. The bioactive constituents of Syrian Rue include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and can be used to treat various health disorders.
